theme_decision: Toggle (Light and Dark). Default to Light Theme to maximize trust, legibility for documents/contracts, and broad accessibility, but offer a sleek 'Midnight' Dark mode for the app-like PWA experience (often preferred by tech-savvy users and drivers at night).

headings.usage: Use Cabinet Grotesk for all H1-H4. It has a modern, slightly wide, and disruptive architectural feel that breaks away from generic SaaS looks. Import via Fontshare CDN.

body.usage: Use Satoshi for body text, inputs, labels, and descriptions. Clean, geometric, and highly readable. Import via Fontshare CDN.

primary.description: Guaraná Orange - high energy, speed, transactional urgency, distinctly Latin American without being a cliché flag color.

trust.description: Emerald Green for verification badges, check-in success, and LGPD compliance signals.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Solid Backgrounds with a sharp 1px border for vehicles cards (The 'Technical' Look). Use 'Crystal Glassmorphism' (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or bg-black/60 with backdrop-saturate-150) EXCLUSIVELY for the sticky navigation and bottom mobile tab bars.
visual_enhancers.borders: Sharp or slightly rounded corners (rounded-md maximum, no pill-shaped cards). For a more mechanical/automotive feel, stick to 4px to 8px max radius.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient + direct shadows for floating CTAs. Cards should remain flat (no shadow) until hovered.

grids_and_layouts.general: Follow 'Generous Spacing Philosophy'. Container internal padding must be p-6 or p-8.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: For vehicle details page highlights (tech, comfort, space), use 'MODE B: High Density Grid' (gap-4). Every pixel utilized.
grids_and_layouts.listing_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 with gap-6. Cards must have a fixed aspect ratio for photos.
grids_and_layouts.mobile_first: Max width for main content constraints, bottom navigation bar on mobile (PWA style). Vehicle images must use max-h-[80vh] md:max-h-none.

motion.hover_states: Cards lift (-translate-y-1) and gain shadow-lg. Buttons get slightly darker on hover. Do NOT use universal 'transition: all'. Use 'transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease'.
motion.page_transitions: Fade-in entrance for the grid lists (staggered if possible).
motion.micro_interactions: Heart (favorite) should scale pop when clicked. Filter sidebars should slide in smoothly.

components.vehicle_card: Photo-first (aspect-video or 4:3). Include Price/day, Rating (★), Brand/Model, Category badge, and Trust verified icon. Sharp edges, 1px subtle border.
components.booking_cta: Sticky on mobile (bottom of screen), sticky right-rail on desktop. Must show total transparent price breakdown (rental + commission/fees + insurance).
components.filters: Sidebar on desktop, full-screen modal on mobile. Intelligent toggle sections.
components.trust_badges: Prominent display of Verification Levels (CNH, Identity) with the Trust color (#00A86B).
components.forms: Progressive onboarding. Floating labels or clear bold labels. Use Shadcn Inputs and Selects but remove the default heavy roundedness.

accessibility.contrast: Text over hero image MUST have a gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/80 via-black/40 to-transparent) to ensure APCA standards.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='vehicle-card-book-button').

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight) for a high-end, premium feel. Run: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
media.image_handling: Hero overlay: max bg-black/50. object-cover for all vehicle cards.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not strictly necessary for MVP to keep PWA lightweight, but Framer Motion (framer-motion) is recommended for staggered card loads and modal slide-ins. Use leaflet for the interactive map integration.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI for standard components (buttons, dialogs, inputs), but heavily customize the radius (set --radius to 0.25rem or 0.5rem max).
Install and use '@phosphor-icons/react' for UI icons.
Implement a PWA-like mobile layout: bottom tab navigation for mobile devices, hiding the top navbar links behind a clean mobile drawer if necessary.
For the booking flow, use a sticky right column on desktop (like Airbnb) and a sticky bottom bar on mobile with the 'Reserve' CTA and Total Price.
Ensure total transparency in pricing - break down the 10-15% commission visually in the booking summary.
Add data-testid attributes to all major interactive elements.
Ensure 'Inter' is NOT used anywhere; load Cabinet Grotesk for Headings and Satoshi for body via Fontshare CDN.
Integrate Leaflet for the interactive map with vehicle pins.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where scrolling content exists underneath (e.g., sticky headers).
NEVER center align the app container via '.App { text-align: center; }'.
Use modern button styles (sharp edges or slight rounding) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header or overlays. Ensure readability.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
